title: Timeboxed admin access provisioning lifecycle and intake prioritization
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement a timeboxed (just-in-time) admin access provisioning lifecycle and intake prioritization flow for enterprise admin/access requests (RBAC, SSO/SAML, SCIM, org policy exceptions). The goal is to reduce mean time to grant safe temporary privileges, provide consistent prioritization across enterprise customers, and capture the metadata needed for auditability and rollbacks.
background: We receive a growing volume of non-bug admin requests from enterprise customers: temporary admin elevation, cross-tenant role delegation, SCIM mapping troubleshooting, SSO/SAML edge cases. Currently triage is manual and inconsistent — long wait times for temporary access and unclear routing to Solutions/Support/Engineering. Customers escalate for compliance-related work and time-sensitive onboarding. This initiative ties into Dedicated & Private onboarding experience and audit logging requirements.
scope_included: Standardized intake form for admin/access requests with fields for role, justification, duration, impacted orgs, linked ticket/CI/CD deploys
Scoring logic to prioritize routed queue by urgency, compliance sensitivity, and customer tier
Automated JIT provisioning playbook integration with RBAC engine to grant timeboxed roles with expiry and auto-revoke
Console visibility: request timeline, expiry, approver, and audit links
Escalation rules and SLA targets (initial response, grant/reject windows) and integration with Support/Solutions teams
scope_excluded: Full rewrite of RBAC engine (engineering follow-up project if needed)
Changes to underlying SAML identity provider integrations beyond configuration templates
On-prem installer changes for Private customers (separate on-prem roadmap)
Long-term policy engine (this ticket implements JIT and intake; policy-as-code follow-up)
acceptance_criteria: Intake form captures required fields: requested role, justification, start/end time, impacted org IDs, SSO/SCIM context, and compliance tags
Automated scoring returns a routing decision (Support / Solutions / Engineering) for >90% of test requests according to rubric
Timeboxed grant path integrated with RBAC engine issues ephemeral token/role with expiry and audit entry
Console displays active timeboxed grants and allows manual revoke; audit logs surface in Compliance view within 24 hours
SLA definitions documented and initial runbook created: initial response <= 48h for P1 enterprise requests, grant or scheduled action <= 5 business days unless security review required
Security review checklist attached to intake for flagged requests; flagged items block automated grant path until approved
success_metrics: Mean time to grant temporary admin reduced from current baseline by 50% within quarter
>85% of enterprise admin requests follow automated routing (reduction in manual reassignment)
Decrease in escalations to on-call engineering for admin provisioning by 40%
Audit completeness: 100% of timeboxed grants have associated justification and expiry metadata
tasks: Draft intake form fields and scoring rubric (PM + Security)
Design screens: console request detail + active grants list (Design)
API: intake endpoint and scoring service prototype (Engineering)
RBAC: implement ephemeral role issuance + revoke endpoint (Engineering runtime team)
Support/Solutions: define routing queues and runbook steps
Legal/Compliance: review audit retention and required metadata
QA: end-to-end testing with enterprise test customer and simulated SSO/SCIM contexts
Rollout plan: pilot with 2 enterprise customers then general rollout
